_method:
Slack and pinch clearance of candidate bundle routes over the neck and jaw motion.

A route (route-candidates.json) is a polyline whose points each ride on one MJCF body ('tie' = fixed to that body by a
tie or clip; 'guide' = held in a passage of that body). At pose q every point moves with its body; spans between points
on different bodies are free spans, modelled taut (straight). For each route and pose set:
  slack needed  = max over poses of (route length at q - route length at q = 0), total and per free span;
  pinch         = smallest exact distance from the route centreline to a part on a body other than the two bodies the
                  span is attached to (minus the conductor-group radius = clearance of the wire surface);
  wrap          = free-span samples (farther than 3 mm from their end points) that lie inside a solid at that pose:
                  the taut line would cut through a part, so the real cable wraps it (length then exceeds the taut value).
Pose sets: 'policy' (box over the walking-policy trace ranges), 'pickup' (neck pitched forward/down, head pitched down,
the bend-forward beak-pickup family), 'mjcf' (each joint alone over its full MJCF range in 10 deg steps).
Jaw 0 and 40 deg (open) in every set. Writes motion.json.
Usage: motion.py [route ...]

current-external.description: V1.8 as built: torso tie at the plate notch to the cap-notch hood tie, one free span behind the neck (taut model of the 130 mm service loop)

A-minus-y-channel.description: Inside route, -y side: pack exit -> tie on ID12 case near the neck-pitch axis -> straight up behind the -y neck links -> tie on the -y arm of the head-pitch bracket at the head-pitch axis -> up through the lower-shell floor opening -> -y channel between ID13 and the jaw-support/lower-shell collar -> above the servos -> over the Pi top edge (current tail) -> header

B-plus-y-gap.description: Inside route, +y side beside the ID11->ID13 servo cable: pack exit -> tie on ID12 case (+y) -> straight up behind the +y neck links -> tie on the +y bracket arm at the head-pitch axis -> floor opening rear +y corner -> gap between the yaw link and the jaw servo ID15 -> above the servos -> over the Pi top (current tail) -> header

A2-minus-y-clips.description: Route A with every tie moved next to the joint axis it serves, each held by a clip under an existing screw head (no new holes): from the V1.8 torso exit over the shell top to a torso clip under the -y shell screw S12-horn-025 beside the neck-pitch pivot (6 mm from the axis); neck clip under the -y link screw S11-case-094 (ID11 case); bracket clip under the -y bracket screw S11-horn-040 beside the head-pitch axis (6 mm from it); then up the bracket plate, through the lower-shell floor opening and the -y channel as route A. Wire points sit 3 mm outboard of the screw seat (screw head plus clip plus half a wire).
